texts.preamble: Akhatar Karim Shaikh vs The State Of Maharashtra on 13 August, 2025 1 of 4 917-Aba.1401.2025 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay Bench At Aurangabad 917 Anticipatory Bail Application No. 1401 Of 2025 Akhatar Karim Shaikh Versus The State Of Maharashtra ...
texts.facts: The Informant is one-Pragya Pramod Surase, aged 36 years. At the very outset, learned Advocate for the Applicant would submit that the alleged crime in the present matter relates to a banned substance i.e. Gutkha. The perusal of the FIR would reveal that the Applicant is the supplier of the said contraband, such contraband which has been duly seized. The name of the Accused person initially was not mentioned in the FIR. It was subsequently revealed from the statement of co-accused during investigation. The Applicant has no criminal antecedents as pointed out by learned Advocate for the Applicant.
texts.arguments: 5. Ms. Barhate, learned Advocate for the Applicant would draw the attention of the Court to an order dated 23 July 2025 in Anticipatory Bail Application No.1248 of 2025, where the Applicant similarly placed has been protected by interim order of this Court.
texts.respondent_arguments: 5. Ms. Barhate, learned Advocate for the Applicant would draw the attention of the Court to an order dated 23 July 2025 in Anticipatory Bail Application No.1248 of 2025, where the Applicant similarly placed has been protected by interim order of this Court.
